expectations.text: Should detect platform using 4-tier priority (config.platform -> hostname map -> URL inference -> fallback)
expectations.evidence: answer 只说「platform=forgejo」来自用户配置, 未提及或体现 4 级优先级探测 (config.platform -> hostname map -> URL 推断 -> fallback)。snapshot issue_status.platform=forgejo 与之一致, 但回答里没有探测过程的证据。

expectations.text: Should call forgejo CLI wrapper (not raw curl) and handle 10 fetch_error enum values (network_unavailable, cli_missing, auth_missing, auth_failed, rate_limited, not_found_or_no_access, timeout, platform_unknown, parse_error, unknown)
expectations.evidence: answer 仅写「4 个仓均无 fetch_error」; 未提及经 forgejo CLI wrapper 抓取 (而非裸 curl), 也未涉及 10 个 fetch_error 枚举值的处理。exec_notes 只记录跑 scan.py, 无 wrapper 调用证据。

expectations.text: Should use cache with 15-minute TTL at .aria/cache/issues.json
expectations.evidence: answer Open Issues 区块写「数据来源: cache (刚刚获取, 2026-09-27T17:09:50Z) | ttl: 15m」; exec_notes 第 5/6 步 ls 并 git check-ignore 了 .aria/cache/issues.json, 副作用说明记录 scan.py 写入该缓存 (mtime 17:09:51Z)。路径与 TTL 均有证据。

expectations.text: Should NOT manage API tokens inside the skill (rely on existing CLI wrapper auth)
expectations.evidence: exec_notes 与 answer 均无任何 token 读取/写入/配置动作; answer 未要求用户提供 token。负向断言成立 (但属恒真类, 见 critique)。

expectations.text: Should attempt heuristic linking of issues to US-NNN patterns and OpenSpec change names (with word boundary protection against URL paths)
expectations.evidence: answer 展示了 OpenSpec 启发式关联 (aria-plugin#204 -> handoff-multibranch-subdir-path-fidelity, #195 -> pre-merge-completeness-gate-change-scope, 与 snapshot 一致), 但完全未提 US-NNN 关联的尝试或结果 (snapshot linked_us 全 null, 回答未说明), 也无词边界保护的任何体现。断言要求 US 与 OpenSpec 两类关联, 只做到一半。

expectations.text: Should recommend triage when blocker/critical labeled issues exist (open_blocker_issues rule)
expectations.evidence: 前提 (存在 blocker/critical 标签) 不成立; answer 正确说明「没有任何 open issue 带 blocker/critical 标签, open_blocker_issues 规则 (priority 1.99) 没有触发」, 规则语义与 snapshot label_summary={'bug':4} 一致, 并解释了打标签后规则会生效。规则判定正确。

expectations.text: Should fail-soft and gracefully degrade when offline (network_unavailable) or CLI missing
expectations.evidence: 本次网络与 CLI 均可用, 未发生降级; answer 未描述离线 / CLI 缺失时的 fail-soft 行为。无法从产出核验。

eval_feedback.overall: 8 条断言中 A2/A3/A8 描述的是 scan.py 内部实现, 在正常联网环境下的最终回答里观察不到, 恒假; A5 恒真; A1/A7 的条件分支本 eval 只能观察一侧。详见 GRADER_CRITIQUE.md。
